data.name: Bhavin
data.long_meaning: Bhavin is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Bhava', which means 'to be' or 'to feel'. The name Bhavin signifies the one who embodies various feelings and emotions. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is known as the 'Bhava Swarup', meaning the embodiment of various emotions and feelings. Thus, the name Bhavin is deeply rooted in the spiritual and emotional dimensions of Hindu culture.
